messages:
mike: hey team, first day here! got the ThinkPad from ops (T14s). Windows setup finished but Intune shows "Enrolled (MAM)" instead of device management and i can't enable BitLocker or install WSL/Docker because i don't have admin. also `dsregcmd /status` says not joined. who should i ping for a short-lived admin? :wave:

it-ash: welcome mike! can you paste the device serial (on sticker or run `wmic bios get serialnumber`) and a screenshot of the Intune device page? also paste output of `dsregcmd /status` and `manage-bde -status C:`. we prefer to re-trigger Autopilot/AzureAD join rather than granting long-lived admin.

mike: serial: PF1ABCD12345. `dsregcmd /status` -> "AzureAdJoined : NO
DeviceId : <blank>
JoinType : None". `manage-bde -status C:` -> "BitLocker Drive Encryption: Off". screenshot of Intune page uploaded (shows Enrollment Type: MAM).

intune-zoe: thanks. looks like the device was registered during user-driven setup but autopilot provisioning didn't complete, so it ended up as MAM-only. i'll re-run the Autopilot join and push the BitLocker policy + local-admin script. i'll queue jobs now. ETA ~15m.

enroll-bot: Job queued: trigger_autopilot_reprovision -> device=PF1ABCD12345 (job=33021)

enroll-bot: Job started: trigger_autopilot_reprovision -> device=PF1ABCD12345 (job=33021)
enroll-bot: Job completed: trigger_autopilot_reprovision -> success (autopilot_reprovisioned)

intune-zoe: Autopilot reprovision succeeded and device rejoined Azure AD. pushing BitLocker enable and a 2-hour temp-admin (local group add) so you can install WSL and Docker Desktop if needed. mdm-bot will post deployments.

it-bot: Temporary admin granted: mike -> 2 hours (added to local "CompanyTempAdmins" group).

mdm-bot: Deployment started: push_bitlocker_policy_33022 -> device=PF1ABCD12345
mdm-bot: Deployment completed: push_bitlocker_policy_33022 -> success (BitLocker enabled, key escrowed to AAD)

mdm-bot: Deployment started: push_local_admin_33023 -> device=PF1ABCD12345
mdm-bot: Deployment completed: push_local_admin_33023 -> success (user added to local group CompanyTempAdmins)

mike: i can see AzureAdJoined : YES now and `manage-bde -status` shows Encryption Percentage: 0% and then progressing. i can `whoami` and see im in the CompanyTempAdmins group. installing WSL and Docker now. quick question: any special corporate config for Docker?

it-ash: once Docker Desktop is installed, make sure you sign into the company SSO and enable the Docker WSL backend. we prefer installing Docker Desktop for Windows (not Hyper-V) on dev machines. also avoid sharing the admin creds — temp admin will be revoked automatically.

mike: Docker and WSL installed fine. BitLocker finished encrypting (Encryption Percentage: 100%). repo pushes working with SSH (ssh key synced via profile). thanks! :thumbsup:

it-ash: leaving the 2-hour window active. i'll revoke earlier if you signal done. filing follow-up to check why Autopilot reprovision was required for this batch.

mike: cleaned up local test containers and removed any test elevated tools. ready to have temp admin revoked. thanks everyone! :raised_hands:

it-bot: Temporary admin revoked: mike -> removed from local group CompanyTempAdmins. closing jobs 33021/33022/33023.
